subject: Introduce XXH_SIZE_OPT and XXH_NO_STREAM

units.name: Introduce XXH_SIZE_OPT and XXH_NO_STREAM
units.evidence: With XXH_NO_STREAM=1 the old streaming wrapper compiles, while the new header intentionally hides XXH64_state_t and XXH64 streaming functions, so there is no common old/new Alive2 target. A separate XXH_SIZE_OPT one-shot target timed out.

notes: The new opt-out deliberately removes streaming declarations; Alive2 requires matching functions for refinement.
